title: Refine Telemetry source trust cues
summary: Refine the Telemetry tab so normal numeric telemetry is visually neutral, fixture-like or warning-sourced telemetry is explicit, GPU row provenance inherits source evidence, and 0% expected NVENC stays primary even when RAM is high.
reason: The follow-up Telemetry scan found residual trust risks where normal values could look like success, fixture/test/read-warning sources could still appear live-normal, structured GPU rows could lose source provenance, and high RAM could obscure expected-but-idle NVENC.
behavior_before: Telemetry normal KPI/chart states used success coloring, source warnings were limited to the trust strip, structured GPU rows without per-row source rendered as not reported, and memory pressure could outrank an active hardware encode with 0% NVENC.
behavior_after: Telemetry normal KPI/chart states are neutral, fixture/test/read-warning source evidence drives a warning operating state, structured GPU rows inherit payload/top-level source, and expected-but-idle NVENC remains the primary warning with high RAM appended as secondary guidance.
